reasons: The PromQL uses a fixed range [5m]; the converter may only use $__rate_interval as a range, so this must be rewritten.

The Datadog metric docker.net.bytes_rcvd is a cumulative byte total per container, but the candidate applies rate(), which changes the quantity to bytes per second. Unless the Datadog value is confirmed to be a rate, the unit (B vs B/s) and quantity differ.
Grouping is correct: docker_image maps to container_image_name, which is observed in the dataset. Aggregation (avg by image) and the dropped $scope template variable match the Datadog request.
Outcome translated is appropriate because an OTel sum metric measuring received bytes exists in the dataset.
